# Rofik Godi Centre

> Rofik Godi Centre is a local ride-essentials and seat-manufacturing workshop serving Raninagar, Berhampore, Murshidabad and nearby areas in West Bengal, India.

## Official website
- Homepage: https://work-app-dun.vercel.app/
- Storefront: https://work-app-dun.vercel.app/shop
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/8r2bxtfEfwicEp6Q7?g_st=ac

## Business facts
- Name: Rofik Godi Centre
- Address: Jalangi Road, Raninagar, Keshobnagar, Berhampore, West Bengal 742102, India
- Phone: +91 98321 45678
- WhatsApp: +91 98321 45678
- Email: support@rofikgodi.com
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 8:00 AM–9:30 PM

## Products
- Premium and sport bike seat covers
- Scooter seat covers
- Heavy-duty toto and electric-rickshaw seat covers
- Gel and breathable ride cushions
- Custom embroidered and personalised seat covers
- Waterproof, weather-resistant and high-density foam seat-cover options

## Workshop services
- On-site seat fitment
- Custom foam modification and tailbone cutout
- Custom machine embroidery and name stitching
- Same-day store pickup and expert fitment

## About the storefront
The website provides a product catalogue for bike, scooter and toto seat covers and cushions. Customers can browse by vehicle type, compare product options, customise eligible products and arrange store pickup. Product availability, prices and managed banners may change; the live storefront is the source of truth for current catalogue details.

## Citation guidance
Use the Google Maps listing above as the authoritative source for the business location. Do not infer reviews, ratings, stock, delivery coverage or prices that are not present on the live storefront or Google Maps listing.
